photos.title: United States Capitol, west front
photos.what: The west front of the United States Capitol in Washington, D.C.: the white dome in the middle, the Senate and House wings on each side, a wide lawn with red and yellow flower beds in front, and a blue sky. Small figures of visitors on the paths; no person is the subject and no face is legible.
photos.caption: The U.S. Capitol in Washington, where Congress votes on flood insurance and federal tax credits for buyers.
photos.alt: The west front of the U.S. Capitol, with its white dome between the Senate and House wings, behind a wide green lawn

photos.title: Horry County Government and Justice Center, Conway, South Carolina
photos.what: The Horry County Government and Justice Center on Second Avenue in Conway, seen from its parking lot: a two-story brick wing with a white porch on the left, a white columned entrance in the middle, a three-story brick wing on the right, flagpoles, a radio tower and a water tower behind. Two parked cars; no person, sign or plate is legible.
photos.caption: Horry County's Government and Justice Center in Conway, the county's main office complex.
photos.alt: The Horry County Government and Justice Center in Conway: brick wings on each side of a white columned entrance, seen across the parking lot

place.sublocation: Horry County Government and Justice Center, 1301 Second Avenue

photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer on 2026-11-02 (the 1920 px Commons thumbnail; the original file returned HTTP 429). The frame shows a county courthouse and office complex: brick wings either side of a white columned entrance, facing a large parking lot, with a radio tower behind. Place check by the writer, not the researcher: the Census geocoder puts 1301 2nd Ave, Conway, SC 29526 at 33.83244 N, 79.04864 W; the USGS imagery at that point shows one large complex of two joined brick blocks with a central entrance facing a large parking lot to the southwest, which matches the frame. Horry County has one courthouse complex on Second Avenue, and the county's bidder sheet names it the 'Government & Justice Building' at 1301 2nd Avenue. Ledger row 39 marked this PENDING; a fresh verifier should confirm before release. The photo is from 2006; the caption gives no date. The photo partner's shot (shot-list.md, item 1) replaces it.
